narrative.details:
A truly amazing story, adventurer! You have my thanks, and the heartfelt gratitude of all who were involved, I can assure you. Through your efforts we are delivered from the mistakes of our past.

As to your reward, I believe I have a few things that you have definitely earned and will truly enjoy.
narrative.objectives: Give Mokvar your Beaststalker's Cap and Beaststalker's Tunic.
narrative.offerRewardText:
I will truly miss you, adventurer. There is a debt that I owe you, which I may never be able to repay.

Enjoy your new head and chest armor. May it protect you for a long time to come, and help you to achieve even greater honor!
narrative.requestItemsText: As per our deal, are you ready to hand over your Beaststalker pieces in exchange for your new Beastmaster's Cap and Tunic?
